s1.syndrome_frame: inflammatory arthritis and skin lesions with systemic symptoms
salient_findings: weight loss without fever or sweats
key_facts: male patient in his 50s
dermal papules on trunk and extremities
preference for extensor surfaces of arms and legs
no lymphadenopathy
normal complete blood cell count and metabolic panel
normal viral and rheumatologic panels
normal chest radiograph and high-resolution chest CT scan
mild restrictive disease on pulmonary function tests
skin biopsy showing nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate
atypical lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes
low CD4 signal and robust CD8 signal on immunostaining
clonal rearrangements identified in skin biopsy and bone marrow samples
lymphocytes with atypical CD3-negative, CD4-negative, CD5-positive, CD8-positive phenotype

differentials: Interstitial lung disease associated with rheumatoid arthritis
Neutrophilic dermatosis of the dorsal hands
per_call: Interstitial lung disease associated with rheumatoid arthritis
Neutrophilic dermatosis of the dorsal hands

shortlist.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: skin biopsy showing nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate, atypical lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes, and clonal rearrangements identified in skin biopsy and bone marrow samples

shortlist.label: Subcutaneous panniculitis-like T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: skin lesions and systemic symptoms, including weight loss and fatigue, with lymphocytes having atypical CD3-negative, CD4-negative, CD5-positive, CD8-positive phenotype

shortlist.label: Lymphomatoid papulosis
shortlist.why_kept: skin lesions with preference for extensor surfaces of arms and legs, and presence of atypical lymphocytes

shortlist.label: Angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: systemic symptoms, including fatigue, dyspnea on exertion, and weight loss, with lymphocytes having atypical phenotype

shortlist.label: Sézary syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: skin lesions, lymphadenopathy not noted but lymphocytes with atypical CD3-negative, CD4-negative, CD5-positive, CD8-positive phenotype, and clonal rearrangements identified in skin biopsy and bone marrow samples

raw.rationale: The presence of atypical lymphocytes, clonal rearrangements in skin and bone marrow, and an inverted CD8:CD4 ratio on immunostaining support the diagnosis of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma. The patient's lack of response to treatments for dermatomyositis and the specific findings on skin biopsy and immunostaining refute the anchor diagnosis.
raw.anchor_refutation: The patient's clinical presentation and laboratory findings, including the presence of atypical lymphocytes and clonal rearrangements, are not typical of dermatomyositis. The lack of muscle involvement and the specific skin biopsy findings also argue against dermatomyositis.

rejected.label: Dermatomyositis
rejected.why: Lack of muscle involvement and atypical skin biopsy findings

rejected.label: Subcutaneous panniculitis-like T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: The patient's skin biopsy did not show the characteristic subcutaneous panniculitis

rejected.label: Lymphomatoid papulosis
rejected.why: The patient's lesions were persistent and not self-resolving, which is atypical for lymphomatoid papulosis

rejected.label: Angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: The patient's laboratory findings did not show the characteristic follicular helper T-cell phenotype

rejected.label: Sézary syndrome
rejected.why: The patient's skin biopsy did not show the characteristic Sézary cells and the patient did not have erythroderma
